_about: The original's draggable handle, arrows.ent, and the fire agent or reflector that follows it (the
program's B4; docs/parity-backlog.md section 6): decoded from android_game.bin through Enhanced's asbc
visuals/briefs/00_order.md 8.0: arguments pushed LAST-FIRST, an immediate printed as a vN, CMPIu v0 is
0) and the engine's input (reference/ethanon). Step 139 of docs/planning/2026-09-11-magic-portals-
remaster.md. Six levels place a handle, one each, each on the point of the node that follows it:
2-27 (level26a) a reflect_agent.ent (the census of the 128 converted levels; test_mp_handle pins it).
No footage of the original shows a handle dragged (out/parity/footage/INDEX.md), so the numbers are the
decode's; the handle's rest alpha and 2-20's hand are measured on the library's stills (the step's gates).

_source: ETHCallback_arrows (MiscCallbacks.angelscript, listing L67305, bytes 340811..341745), every frame. arrows.ent
is static=0 with a callback, so it is always active: it runs in ETHScene::Update's first walk, BEFORE the
scene's update script (the camera, the portal manager) and before the static callbacks (the fire agent,
the reflector) (Scene/ETHScene.cpp:467-482; Scene/ETHActiveEntityHandler.cpp:72-73).
#4-16 SetUInt('moving', 0). #17-178 for t in 0..1 (CMPIu v6[t], v2: the immediate 2, two touches):
#21-27 GetTouchState(t) == 1 (GSKS_HIT, the first held frame); #29-65 isPointInRect(GetTouchPos(t) +
GetCameraPos(), GetPositionXY(), GetSize(), V2_HALF) - the touch's point in the level inside the rect
of the entity's size centred on its point (isPointInRect 319410..319788: pos - size x origin, both edges
INCLUSIVE); #67-86 then SetVector2('onHitPos' + t, GetPositionXY()): where the handle stood when that
touch went down on it. #89-97 GetTouchState(t) != 2 (GSKS_DOWN: held, not its first frame) -> nothing
more for that touch; #98-139 else isPointInRect(g_touchManager.getRelativeHitPos(t), GetVector2('onHitPos'
+ t), GetSize(), V2_HALF) - TouchInputManager::update (159141..159915 #86-104) sets relativeHitPos[t] =
the touch + GetCameraPos() on the HIT frame, after this callback (the manager runs in the scene script),
so the point of the level the touch went down on is tested against the rect where the handle stood
then; GetVector2 of a name never set is (0, 0) (00_order 8.0: a missing datum is 0). #143-160
AddToPositionXY(capVector(GetTouchMove(t), scale(64))) - capVector (utilMath 317037..317257): the move
itself when dp2(v, v) <= 64^2, else normalize(v) x 64 (max_frame_move_units); #161-173 SetUInt('moving',
1) - SET ON EVERY DOWN FRAME whose hit was on the handle, whether or not the finger moved. GetTouchMove
is gs2d MobileInput's current - last on a DOWN frame, 0 on HIT, RELEASE and UP (MobileInput.cpp:99-120),
in screen px, which AddToPositionXY adds as the level's own: so the handle follows the finger ONE FOR
ONE on the screen, 64 units a frame at most (scale(n) is n units, 00_order 8.0 rule 5).
#179-200 GetUInt('moving') CMPIu 0, JNZ: 0 -> SetAlpha(0.3) (idle_alpha), else SetAlpha(1)
(moving_alpha) - FAINT AT REST, WHOLE WHILE MOVED (the program's spec words it the other way round; the
bytecode and the library's 2-20 stills, where the arrows are faint, agree). #201-220 bounce(this,
vector2(1.1, 1), vector2(1, 1.1), 300) (bounce_*, utilEntityEffect 327057..327527: its own clock on
g_timeManager's frame time, a leg a stride, odd legs backwards, smoothEnd - Art::Pulse; SetScale, so
GetSize() - and the rect a touch is tested against - is the picture's size at the last call's scale).
size_units: GetSize() is the sprite's frame times its scale (sim/Fire.hpp's note): arrows.png is 64 x 64
with no hd twin, arrows.ent SpriteCut 1 x 1 and Scale 1, and no level node scales it.
CameraController::shouldLockCamera (108274..108505): any of the handles the constructor gathered
(GetEntityArray('arrows.ent'), 105826..106336 #101-114) with GetUInt('moving') != 0; dragMoveCamera
(108505..109260) #3-7 returns at once while it is: no pan and no hold judged (camera.json drag).
doFollow (MiscCallbacks.angelscript, listing L67201, bytes 340369..340811): #1-18 entName =
GetString('follow'); #19-32 nothing when it is ''; #33-52 dest = seekNeighbourEntity(GetBucket(its
point), ByNameChooser(entName)), #53-68 else SeekEntity(entName) - by that exact name; #69-95 when found,
followUp(this, vector2(dest.GetPositionXY()), 600, 100, true). Its callers are ETHCallback_fire_agent
#274-280, AFTER its burn loop (so a flame burns where the last frame left it and then moves), and
ETHCallback_reflect_agent #1-6, FIRST (so it moves and then turns a shot) (callers).
followUp (utilEntityEffect.angelscript 328407..329130) takes (thisEntity, destPos, interpStride,
updateRate, dontPause) - v-2 interpStride, v-3 updateRate, and doFollow pushes true, 100, 600 last-first:
stride 600 (interp_stride_ms), rate 100 (update_rate_ms), dontPause true. #1-69 on the first call a
PositionInterpolator from its point to destPos over the stride, filtered by smoothEnd, and switchTime 0;
#93-145 re-aimed from getCurrentPos() only when destPos is not its point AND switchTime > updateRate
(CMPu, TP: strictly); #146-168 switchTime += GetLastFrameElapsedTime() (dontPause: the frame's time,
which a pause does not stop); #170-179 update, then SetPositionXY(getCurrentPos()). The same arithmetic
as ghost_appear_effect's chase (effects.json, Effects::FollowUp), which this reuses.
Both followers are static=1 (fire_agent.ent, reflect_agent.ent): a static entity may be moved
(ETHEntity::SetPositionXY requests the bucket move, Entity/ETHEntity.cpp:370-375), and its callback
runs while its bucket is on the view (00_order 8.12c), which the port does not model (the planning
record's deviations).
2-20 (level19a) is the one level that places hand_waypoint0 (at (165, 191), beside its handle at (162,
192); the census of the 128 converted levels). No .ent: the node is dynamic (no eth_static), so its
callback runs in the always-active walk after the handle's (a later id, 1147 against 1116).
ETHCallback_hand_waypoint0 (ETHCallback_hand_waypoint.angelscript, 366560..368220). FIRST CALL (no
'originalPos', #1-12): #14-27 originalPos = its point; #29-32 WaypointManager(repeat: SetV1 v3, v1 is
the constant 1); six addWaypoint calls, each Waypoint(pos = scale(vector2(x, y)), time, FloatColor(c),
filter, angle 0) with vector2's x pushed LAST: #34-66 (0, 0), 100 ms, FloatColor(16777215),
smoothBeginning; #68-100 (0, 0), 0 ms, FloatColor(-1), smoothBeginning; #102-134 (0, 0), 1200 ms,
FloatColor(-1), smoothBeginning; #136-168 (0, 25), 1500 ms, FloatColor(-1), smoothEnd; #170-202 (70, 10),
400 ms, FloatColor(-1), smoothEnd; #204-236 (70, 10), 0 ms, FloatColor(16777215), smoothEnd - a round of
3200 ms: fade in at the handle, press 25 down, drag 70 right and 15 back up, fade out. FloatColor(uint)
(utilColors 86246..86521): a = (c & 0xFF000000) >> 24, so 16777215 = 0x00FFFFFF is alpha 0 and -1 alpha 1
(alpha). EVERY CALL: #277-279 manager.update() (the 1-21 hand's WaypointManager, camera.json hint);
#280-291 current = getCurrentPoint() - which mixes position AND colour of this waypoint into the next
by this waypoint's filter (WaypointManager::getCurrentPoint 41513..42094 #82-101); #293-319
SetPositionXY(originalPos + current.pos); #320-328 SetAlpha(current.color.a). No life: it is never
deleted for its age. #330-384 the handle: seekNeighbourEntity(GetBucket(its point),
ByNameChooser('arrows.ent')), else SeekEntity('arrows.ent') (handle_name); #385-397 when its
GetUInt('moving') != 0: #398-432 AddScaledEntity('smoke_vanish.ent', GetPosition() - vector3(0,
scale(32), 0), getScale()) (effects.json smoke_vanish) and #433-441 DeleteEntity(thisEntity): the
lesson goes the frame the handle is first held.
